# Tobias Sittenauer

> Full-stack TypeScript developer and fractional CTO based in Weihmichl, Lower Bavaria, Germany. Builds EU-sovereign, GDPR-native software. Founder of StackForge and an active open source maintainer.

Tobias Sittenauer is a technology leader and hands-on software architect focused on scalable backend architectures, cloud infrastructure, and high-quality engineering. Core stack: TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, Next.js, React, React Native, Kubernetes, Docker, and Linux self-hosting. An AI engineer from the first hour, he integrated AI into his workflow with the very first public version of GPT and has worked with it ever since.

This site is a static React + Vite portfolio and CV. There is no tracking and no analytics.
